messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #462 adds a bunch of function-calling examples with JSON schema, but Pulumi reported a parse failure for optional-array outputs when using the SDK snippets. Can someone take a look?

sam: saw that, thanks. which example exactly?

maya: the 'task_list' example in examples/structured-output.md — looks like the schema uses \"items\": { ... } instead of wrapping in an array when nullable. Repro steps in the CI log: 
```
# failing output from llama
{\n  \"tasks\": null\n}
```
parses fine in docs preview but the SDK helper throws on client-side validation.

lin: I think we have two issues: (1) the example schema isn't marking the array as nullable properly, (2) our snippets show the types as `List[Task]` instead of `Optional[List[Task]]` in Python. Small fix.

zach: I can patch the schema to use "type": ["array", "null"] and add a short note about canonicalizing empty vs null arrays. Does that cover it?

sam: that should. Also we need to update the TS SDK snippet — currently it does: `tasks: Task[]` but should be `tasks?: Task[] | null` for the generated type.

alex: tagging SDK owners — @sam @lin — can you add a one-line change in the snippet file and I'll pick up the docs link fix?

sam: will do a tiny PR for the snippet (tests included). ETA today.

maya: alex — when you update the docs, can you also add a short migration note under 'Parsing gotchas' so users know why this changed (client validation strictness)? Something like: \"Note: SDKs now reflect nullable arrays — if you previously relied on empty-array fallthrough, please adapt your client code.\"

alex: yup. I'll add that and include a cross-link to the SDK CHANGELOG entry. Also will run the docs lint locally.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview build failed for PR #462 — `broken-example-check` error (details: https://ci.redwood.example/462/build/12).

lin: thanks — once sam's snippet PR merges, I can re-run local parse tests against the fixed schema.

zach: one more thing: can we add a tiny example showing the `parse_fallback` pattern for nullable arrays? authors asked for a minimal snippet. Something like:
```
{
  "tasks": null
}
# fallback in parse helper
parsed.tasks = parsed.tasks ?? []
```
should be enough.

maya: good call. That will prevent folks from being surprised. I'll drop that inline example below the schema.

alex: created follow-up issue #489 to track the CHANGELOG + migration note + link patch. adding to sprint.

sam: PR for SDK snippet opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/782 — small edits, tests updated.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview build passed for PR #465 (link-fix) — remaining blocker is SDK merge.

maya: great. timeline: sam merges, z runs parse tests, alex merges docs update, then we can close this thread. Thanks all. :pray:
